habit.meaning: something you do regularly, often without thinking

happy.meaning: enjoying or showing or marked by joy or pleasure

harem.meaning: living quarters reserved for wives and concubines and female relatives in a Muslim household

harsh.example: wild and harsh country full of hot sand and cactus

hatch.meaning: come out of an egg; a small door or opening

haunt.meaning: follow stealthily or recur constantly and spontaneously to
haunt.example: the ghost of her mother haunted her

haven.meaning: a shelter serving as a place of safety or sanctuary

hazel.meaning: of a light brown or yellowish brown color

heart.meaning: the organ that pumps blood; the centre of feelings

heath.meaning: a low evergreen shrub of the family Ericaceae

heavy.meaning: of comparatively great physical weight or density

hedge.meaning: a fence formed by a row of closely planted shrubs or bushes

hefty.meaning: large and heavy; (of a sum) large

hello.example: every morning they exchanged polite hellos

hence.meaning: (used to introduce a logical conclusion) from that fact or reason or as a result
hence.example: the eggs were fresh and hence satisfactory

heron.meaning: a tall wading bird with long legs and a long beak

hinge.meaning: a joint that holds two parts together so that one can swing relative to the other

hippo.meaning: a huge thick-skinned African animal that lives in rivers

hoard.meaning: a secret store of valuables or money

hobby.meaning: an activity done for pleasure in free time

homer.meaning: a base hit on which the batter scores a run

honey.meaning: a sweet yellow liquid produced by bees

horse.meaning: a large four-legged animal ridden or used for pulling loads

hotel.meaning: a building where travelers can pay for lodging and meals and other services

hound.meaning: any of several breeds of dog used for hunting typically having large drooping ears

house.meaning: a dwelling that serves as living quarters for one or more families
house.example: he has a house on Cape Cod

hovel.meaning: small crude shelter used as a dwelling

hover.meaning: stay in one place in the air

humid.meaning: containing or characterized by a great deal of water vapor

humor.meaning: the quality of being funny; a mood

hunch.meaning: an impression that something might be the case

hunky.meaning: informal: strong and attractive (of a man); 'hunky-dory' means fine

husky.meaning: a thick-coated sled dog; (of a voice) deep and hoarse

hutch.meaning: a cage (usually made of wood and wire mesh) for small animals

hyena.meaning: doglike nocturnal mammal of Africa and southern Asia that feeds chiefly on carrion
